name: Waterski 3D
summary: Waterski 3D puts you on a high-speed ride behind a motorboat, dodging oil slicks and mines while lining up for risky ski jumps. Overspeeding explodes your boat, while hesitating turns you into shark bait. After a six-lap time trial to qualify, you dive into the brutal suicide course where precision and nerves are everything. Realistic water physics and breakneck pace make for a thrilling, stomach-flipping ride.
